ui_bugs.issue: Bug 4 NOT FIXED — <TextInput type="date" /> on RN-Web does NOT forward the `type` attribute to the DOM. Rendered HTML: `<input autocomplete="on" ... value="">` with `type='text'`. No HTML5 date picker opens; the field appears as a completely blank/empty gray input (no placeholder either). Fix requires either: (a) rendering a raw `<input type="date" />` when Platform.OS==='web' (bypass RN TextInput), or (b) using a web-compatible date-picker library. Confirmed via DOM inspection: `document.querySelector('[data-testid="imp-0-repl-date"]').type === 'text'`.

Bug 2 fix NOT APPLIED to primary planning cards. The `st.statusBadge` style STILL uses `position: 'absolute', top: 8, right: 8` (see CaseImplantPlanning.tsx L2271). Only the *revision* cards (L895-899) use the new inline `st.statusChip` next to the title. On case REG-P2B (699fc5c2248100e8a0d87265) the visible ACTIVE badge is still an absolutely-positioned pill in the top-right of the card (screenshot regp2b_ip_section.png). No visual overlap manifests with the short 'Alpha Bio - ICE' title at 1280px viewport, but the review-request stated the fix would be applied to *primary* cards too.

data-testid attributes set on RN `<View>` are NOT forwarded to the DOM by react-native-web. Consequence: [data-testid='implant-plan-status-0'] and [data-testid='implant-plan-0'] and [data-testid='survival-history'] cannot be found via CSS query. Only <TextInput> (which becomes <input>) and Text-based Touchables reliably forward data-testid. This blocks automated E2E selectors and is a known repeating issue across iterations.

integration_issues.issue: Deep-linking to a procedure via a fresh navigation (e.g., page.goto()) returns 403 in the frontend even when the same user's curl to GET /api/procedures/{id} returns 200. Suspect the auth interceptor / token hydration race — token is stored in localStorage but the axios request fires before the interceptor picks it up on the first render. Workaround for testing: navigate through My Cases search + click. Not a new regression (also seen in iter-296).

rca of the issue: Bug 4 RCA: The fix uses `<TextInput type="date" />` with `@ts-ignore`. Author's mental model: RN-Web will forward the `type` prop to the underlying `<input>` element. Reality: RN-Web has a strict allowlist of props it forwards to the DOM `<input>` (autocomplete, autocapitalize, dir, rows, spellcheck, virtualkeyboardpolicy, class, data-testid, value, and a small set of event handlers). Arbitrary props like `type` are dropped during the ReactNative → HTML translation, so the rendered `<input>` has `type='text'` (default). The correct pattern on web is to render a raw HTML `<input>` element via `React.createElement('input', {...})` — this bypasses the RN component and gives full control of DOM attributes. Bug 2 RCA: The developer added an inline chip to the *revision* card branch (L895-899) but forgot to also refactor the *primary* card branch (L727-768) which still uses the absolute `statusBadge` at L2271. Both branches need the same fix.
